title: Tensor-compatible adjunction squares preserve projection maps
statement: Let C,D,C\prime,D\prime be categories, F:D→C and F\prime:D\prime→C\prime left adjoint to G and G\prime, and N_D:D→D\prime and N_C:C→C\prime functors. Let α:N_D F\prime≅F N_C be a natural isomorphism. Give the four categories tensor bifunctors T_C,T_D,T_C\prime,T_D\prime, comparisons φ:F(T_D(-,-))→T_C(F(-),F(-)) and φ\prime, and natural tensor comparison isomorphisms m_C,m_D for N_C,N_D. Suppose ComparisonCompatible α φ φ\prime m_C m_D: the two tensor comparisons across α agree. Define P and P\prime as the adjoint transposes of φ followed by counit tensor identity, and β as the mate [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-mate] of α. For M∈C,L∈D, N_D(P(M,L)) followed by β at T_C(M,FL) and G\prime of m_C(M,FL) followed by tensoring α_L^{-1}, equals m_D(GM,L) followed by tensoring β_M with identity and P\prime(N_CM,N_DL). No invertibility hypothesis on β or P is needed.

proof.text: Apply the inverse adjunction Hom bijection for F\prime. Substitute the counit formula for the mate β and the formula for the transpose of each projection map. Move the square isomorphism, tensor comparison, and tensor pullback comparison across the counit by naturality. The ComparisonCompatible equality identifies the remaining middle composites. Functoriality of the tensor bifunctor and the mate counit formula cancel the remaining factors. This is the existing complete Lean proof map_rightAdjointProjectionMap_comp_mateEquiv; no new proof obligation is introduced.

lemma map_rightAdjointProjectionMap_comp_mateEquiv
    (H : ComparisonCompatible α φ φ' m_C m_D) (M : C) (L : D) :
    N_D.map (((adj.rightAdjointProjectionMap φ).app M).app L) ≫
        (mateEquiv adj adj' α.hom).app ((T_C.obj M).obj (F.obj L)) ≫
        G'.map ((m_C.hom.app M).app (F.obj L) ≫ (T_C'.obj (N_C.obj M)).map (α.inv.app L)) =
      (m_D.hom.app (G.obj M)).app L ≫ (T_D'.map ((mateEquiv adj adj' α.hom).app M)).app _ ≫
        ((adj'.rightAdjointProjectionMap φ').app (N_C.obj M)).app (N_D.obj L)
